title: CIEmetaDB
description: Data model for the CIE metadatabase: an aggregate store of CIEmetaDigitalProduct (DataCite-based) metadata entries with per-entry change history, audit trail, CIE-division domains and optimistic-concurrency anchors. The payload of each entry validates against CIEmetaDigitalProduct_schema_04.json.
$comment:
Corrections, dbSchemaVersion stays 1. This file is not embedded in CIEmetaDB.html and is not consulted at run time - the tool checks dbSchemaName and dbSchemaVersion only - so it had drifted from the data model it describes. None of the following can invalidate a database that was valid before: two fields were already being written and are now declared, and one constraint is widened.

- landingPage declared on an entry. Written by the tool since the Crossref export was added, and part of the per-entry fingerprint behind baseHash, but undeclared here. It validated only because no object in this schema sets additionalProperties: false.
- rev minimum lowered from 1 to 0 and history minItems from 1 to 0. A new entry that has not been published yet has rev 0 and no history - the ordinary result of 'New entry' - so saving a database containing one produced a file that failed this schema. The constraints described the published case as if it were the only one.
- The nine cr* Crossref deposit fields declared under defaults. Same omission as landingPage: written by the tool, undeclared here.
- baseHash description corrected. It said 'sha256 over the ordered list of entry contentHashes', which the code has not done since envelope fields became versioned outside the payload; the hash is over each entry's contentHash combined with its status, domains and landingPage.
- rev description corrected. It said 'incremented on every committed change'; only publishing creates a revision, and saving a draft deliberately does not.
- payload description corrected. It said metadataRevision mirrors rev, which holds for a published entry but not for a draft, where it is rev + 1 - the revision the draft will become.
- history description extended to say what it does not contain: a draft's pending payload is recorded only when published, so for a draft the history replays to the last published revision rather than to payload.

These corrections landed alongside the three-state model (draft / review / published), and one of them is what makes it representable: 'draft' is defined here as rev 0 with no history, which the previous minimum of 1 rejected.

The derived fields (contentHash, history[].baseHash, the patch chain and baseHash) are checked by db_integrity.js, which reports them per entry and can repair them. It also checks the fields derived from the entry rather than the payload - that status agrees with kindOf(), and that each revisionOf resolves to exactly one published parent - but only reports those, since they are editorial.

Known limitation: the per-entry fingerprint behind baseHash covers status, domains and landingPage, so it notices that a revision exists, but it does not cover revisionOf itself. Repointing a revision at a different parent would therefore not drift baseHash. Including it would change every stored baseHash, so it is recorded here rather than done.

domain.description: A CIE activity domain (typically a CIE Division).

code.description: Short code, e.g. D1, D2, D8.

historyRecord.description: One committed revision of an entry. patch is the forward RFC-6902 diff from the previous revision (rev 1 diffs from the empty document {}), so any revision N can be reconstructed by replaying patches 1..N onto {}.

comment.description: Change comment supplied by the editor.

baseHash.description: sha256 of the payload BEFORE this patch was applied (null for rev 1).

entryId.description: Internal stable identity, independent of the DOI. Used to match entries across DB files during merge.

rev.description: Number of published revisions. Incremented only by publishing, never by saving a draft, so it always equals the length of history. 0 for an entry that has never been published, whose history is correspondingly empty.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the canonical (stable-key-order) JSON of payload at this revision. Used for concurrency/merge conflict detection.

status.description: Editorial workflow state, derived from the entry rather than chosen by a user. 'draft': a new record (New entry / Duplicate) that has never been published; rev is 0. 'review': a revision of a published record, prepared in parallel with it and displayed as 'under revision'; revisionOf identifies the published entry it revises. 'published': the current published record.

revisionOf.description: Present only on a 'review' entry: the entryId of the published entry being revised. The revision is a clone of that entry - history and rev included - so the two coexist and share a DOI while the revision is prepared. Because that DOI duplication is legitimate and temporary, it is exempt from the uniqueness rule. Publishing the revision appends rev+1 to the inherited history, removes the published parent and clears this field, collapsing the pair back into a single published entry.

domains.description: Zero or more domain codes referencing db.domains[].code.

landingPage.description: URL of the DOI landing page for this dataset, deposited as the Crossref <resource> element. Empty string when not yet known. An envelope field like status and domains: it is versioned outside the payload, is editable on a published entry, and does not advance metadataRevision - but it does take part in the per-entry fingerprint behind db.baseHash.

payload.description: The CIEmetaDigitalProduct metadata record. Validates against CIEmetaDigitalProduct_schema_04.json. Carries an optional integer 'metadataRevision', the revision of the metadata file itself: it equals the entry 'rev' for a published entry and rev + 1 for a draft, which is the revision that draft will become when published. It advances only on payload-content changes, never on envelope changes such as status, domains or landingPage.

history.description: One record per published revision, append-only, oldest to newest, with history[i].rev == i+1. Empty for an entry that has never been published. A draft is not represented here: its pending payload is only recorded when it is published, so for a draft the history replays to the last published revision rather than to payload.

validationLog.description: Append-only log of CSV validation runs the editor chose to record (date, editor, file, computed hashes, per-check results). Independent of history.

fileName.description: Name of the CSV file that was validated.

passed.description: true when no check failed (warnings do not fail).

check.description: Check key, e.g. md5, sha256, fileName, numberOfRows, sumOfColumns, sampleRow.

dbId.description: Stable identity of this metadatabase instance.

baseHash.description: sha256 over the entries in order, each contributing its contentHash followed by '~' and the canonical JSON of its envelope fields {status, domains sorted, landingPage}, the parts joined by '|'. The envelope fields are included so that an envelope-only edit - reclassifying a division, filling in a landing page - still drifts this hash rather than passing unnoticed. Concurrency anchor: an importing app compares this to detect divergence.

lastModifiedDate.description: When the database (any entry or DB-level field) was last modified.

lastModifiedBy.description: Editor identity that last modified the database.

domains.description: The editable catalogue of CIE activity domains (Divisions) selectable per entry.

defaults.description: Editable default values (one per field) used to pre-fill auto-filled fields on new entries and available via 'Revert fields to defaults'. publicationYear is not stored here; new entries always use the current year. The cr* keys are not payload defaults at all: they are the depositor, registrant and institution details of the Crossref deposit header, used by 'Create Crossref-file (XML)' and stored here because they belong to the database rather than to any one entry.

crDepositorEmail.description: Crossref deposit header: depositor e-mail address for the submission log.

crRegistrant.description: Crossref deposit header: organisation registering the DOIs.

crDatabaseTitle.description: Crossref: title of the database the datasets belong to.

crPublisherName.description: Crossref: publisher name of the database.

crInstitutionName.description: Crossref: full name of the publishing institution.

crInstitutionAcronym.description: Crossref: acronym of the publishing institution.

crInstitutionPlace.description: Crossref: place of the publishing institution.

crInstitutionDepartment.description: Crossref: department within the publishing institution.
